section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study sample of 228 undergraduate Black female college students (M age = 19.89, SD = 4.57) at a large urban university in the Mid-Atlantic. Recruitment was from a Psychology 101 participant pool and other psychology courses; class-year breakdown (first-year, sophomore, junior, senior, graduate) is reported. BMI was calculated from self-reported height and weight (Mean BMI = 24.71, SD = 6.04).
